review.source: Actual written N1904 and the publisher rows, reviewed against the displayed BSB by Claude (Anthropic); independent peer review recorded in the registry.

9:1.sourceText: Οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐλεύθερος; οὐκ εἰμὶ ἀπόστολος; οὐχὶ Ἰησοῦν τὸν Κύριον ἡμῶν ἑόρακα; οὐ τὸ ἔργον μου ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Κυρίῳ;
9:1.targetText: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you yourselves not my workmanship in the Lord?

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

9:2.sourceText: εἰ ἄλλοις οὐκ εἰμὶ ἀπόστολος, ἀλλά γε ὑμῖν εἰμι· ἡ γὰρ σφραγίς μου τῆς ἀποστολῆς ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Κυρίῳ.
9:2.targetText: Even if I am not an apostle to others, surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

groups.note: ἀλλά γε ("yet at least") is rendered surely.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

9:3.sourceText: Ἡ ἐμὴ ἀπολογία τοῖς ἐμὲ ἀνακρίνουσίν ἐστιν αὕτη.
9:3.targetText: This is my defense to those who scrutinize me:

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

9:4.sourceText: μὴ οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν;
9:4.targetText: Have we no right to food and to drink?

groups.note: The infinitive φαγεῖν ("to eat") is rendered to food.

unmappedSource.reason: μή marks a question expecting the answer no; English has no separate word for it here.

9:5.sourceText: μὴ οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν ἀδελφὴν γυναῖκα περιάγειν, ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ Κηφᾶς;
9:5.targetText: Have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?

groups.note: ἀδελφήν ("a sister", a fellow believer) is rendered believing.

unmappedSource.reason: μή marks a question expecting the answer no; English has no separate word for it here.
BSB leaves καί ("also") untranslated.

9:10.sourceText: ἢ δι’ ἡμᾶς πάντως λέγει; δι’ ἡμᾶς γὰρ ἐγράφη, ὅτι ὀφείλει ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι ὁ ἀροτριῶν ἀροτριᾶν, καὶ ὁ ἀλοῶν ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι τοῦ μετέχειν.

groups.note: BSB asks a question expecting yes; there is no separate Greek negative.

9:11.sourceText: Εἰ ἡμεῖς ὑμῖν τὰ πνευματικὰ ἐσπείραμεν, μέγα εἰ ἡμεῖς ὑμῶν τὰ σαρκικὰ θερίσομεν;
9:11.targetText: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much for us to reap a material harvest from you?

groups.note: εἰ ("if") is rendered by the construction for … to reap.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

9:12.sourceText: εἰ ἄλλοι τῆς ὑμῶν ἐξουσίας μετέχουσιν, οὐ μᾶλλον ἡμεῖς; ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐχρησάμεθα τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ ταύτῃ, ἀλλὰ πάντα στέγομεν ἵνα μή τινα ἐνκοπὴν δῶμεν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
9:12.targetText: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.

groups.note: The genitive ὑμῶν ("over you") is rendered to your.
BSB repeats have where the Greek leaves the verb understood.
οὐ ("not") is rendered shouldn’t; the Greek question has no verb of its own.
ἵνα μή ("so that not") is rendered rather than.
ἐνκοπὴν δῶμεν ("give a hindrance") is rendered hinder.

9:13.sourceText: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ τὰ ἱερὰ ἐργαζόμενοι τὰ ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἐσθίουσιν, οἱ τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ παρεδρεύοντες τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ συνμερίζονται;
9:13.targetText: Do you not know that those who work in the temple eat of its food, and those who serve at the altar partake of its offerings?

groups.note: ἱερά ("sacred things", the temple service) is rendered in the temple.
τὰ ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ("the things from the temple") is rendered its food.
τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ ("with the altar") is rendered its.
Same word, spelled differently in BSB's Greek text.

9:14.sourceText: οὕτως καὶ ὁ Κύριος διέταξεν τοῖς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον καταγγέλλουσιν ἐκ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ζῆν·

groups.note: ζῆν ("to live") is rendered should receive their living.

unmappedSource.reason: BSB leaves καί ("also") untranslated.

unmappedTarget.reason: English adds that.

9:15.sourceText: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ κέχρημαι οὐδενὶ τούτων. οὐκ ἔγραψα δὲ ταῦτα ἵνα οὕτως γένηται ἐν ἐμοί· καλὸν γάρ μοι μᾶλλον ἀποθανεῖν ἢ —τὸ καύχημά μου οὐδεὶς κενώσει.
9:15.targetText: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that something be done for me. Indeed, I would rather die than let anyone nullify my boast.

groups.note: καλὸν … μᾶλλον ("better rather") is rendered would rather.
οὐδείς ("no one") is rendered anyone after rather … than.

unmappedSource.reason: BSB leaves οὕτως ("so, in this way") untranslated.

9:16.sourceText: ἐὰν γὰρ εὐαγγελίζωμαι, οὐκ ἔστιν μοι καύχημα· ἀνάγκη γάρ μοι ἐπίκειται· οὐαὶ γάρ μοί ἐστιν ἐὰν μὴ εὐαγγελίσωμαι.
9:16.targetText: Yet when I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because I am obligated to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!

groups.note: ἀνάγκη … ἐπίκειται ("necessity lies on") is rendered am obligated.

unmappedSource.reason: BSB leaves γάρ ("for") untranslated.
BSB's exclamation has no verb for ἐστιν ("is").

unmappedTarget.reason: English supplies what the obligation is.

9:17.sourceText: εἰ γὰρ ἑκὼν τοῦτο πράσσω, μισθὸν ἔχω· εἰ δὲ ἄκων, οἰκονομίαν πεπίστευμαι.
9:17.targetText: If my preaching is voluntary, I have a reward. But if it is not voluntary, I am still entrusted with a responsibility.

groups.note: Greek I do this willingly is recast as my preaching is voluntary. The actual willing adjective, demonstrative object and first-person doing verb form the whole short predicate; preaching identifies this doing from its gospel-preaching context.

Greek unwilling qualifies the implicit first-person agent; BSB expresses the same condition as it is not voluntary, referring to the preaching. The whole unwilling condition is retained with this agent-to-action and adjective-to-negative-clause recasting explicit.

unmappedSource.reason: BSB does not separately express the opening explanatory Greek for.

unmappedTarget.reason: BSB adds continuative still with the entrusting statement; no separate continuation adverb is printed in N1904.

9:18.sourceText: τίς οὖν μού ἐστιν ὁ μισθός; ἵνα εὐαγγελιζόμενος ἀδάπανον θήσω τὸ εὐαγγέλιον, εἰς τὸ μὴ καταχρήσασθαι τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ μου ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ.
9:18.targetText: What then is my reward? That in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge, and so not use up my rights in preaching it.
